Ten numbered cells in a 5-column, 2-row grid, EACH ISOLATED ASSET drawn using the SAME orthographic isometric camera and SAME pixels-per-meter, no individual auto-rescaling. Tall pieces clearly taller than floor pieces. Small ruler and one 1.20m character at the side or footer, not an 11th module.
Assets and exact labels:
01 纸院地面 / 2.0 × 2.0 × 0.10: pale warm cut-paper paving flat square, layered edge.
02 印坊地面 / 2.0 × 2.0 × 0.10: honey beige wide wooden planks in paper material, same tile square and thickness.

06 低前墙 / 2.0 × 0.20 × 0.45: very low cream paper parapet, subtle blue coping included in height.
07 方柱 / 0.20 × 0.20 × 2.40: single upright square wooden pillar.

Under footer put exactly “角色含帽高 1.20m · 台高 0.65m · 通道净宽 2.40m” and “美术比例拟案 · 尺寸以清单为准”.
